about: Where Lumen's production runs, and on what plan (plan W6.9, docs self-hosting/cut-over). `npm run hosting:gate` (also the first step of scripts/vercel-build.mjs and scripts/pages-deploy.sh) fails a build that takes money on a host whose plan forbids commercial use. Update this file in the same commit as the host change.

vercel.why: Vercel Hobby is for personal, non-commercial use only (vercel.com/docs/limits/fair-use-guidelines). Set plan to "pro" and commercial to true only after the upgrade.

cloudflare-pages.why: Cloudflare Pages Free has no non-commercial clause (developers.cloudflare.com/pages/platform/limits; Cloudflare's self-serve terms).
